evidence.title: Trump’s tougher round-two birthright citizenship strategy hinges on key legal distinction, experts say

occurrences.checkable_against: August 6, 2026 presidential executive order on birthright citizenship
occurrences.quote_span: Trump’s order argues that members of foreign terrorist organizations can fall within that enemy exception.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: Statements by experts from the Manhattan Institute, America First Legal and America First Policy Institute
occurrences.quote_span: Experts from the Manhattan Institute, America First Legal and the America First Policy Institute, all right-of-center organizations, argued that Trump’s new order is narrower than his first and is built around longstanding exceptions to birthright citizenship that they believe could apply here.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: August 6, 2026 presidential executive order on birthright citizenship
occurrences.quote_span: The first, signed Aug. 6, directs federal agencies to withhold documents recognizing citizenship from certain children born when neither parent is a U.S. citizen, including some whose parents are members of designated foreign terrorist organizations , foreign-government employees or participants in transactions or fraud intended to obtain birthright citizenship.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: United States v. Wong Kim Ark and Amanda Frost statement reported by Fox News
occurrences.quote_span: Amanda Frost, a professor at the University of Virginia School of Law, pointed out that United States v. Wong Kim Ark specifies that only children of enemies "occupying" some portion of the country are barred from citizenship at birth, meaning that Trump’s order would not apply to terrorists simply residing within the country.
occurrences.speaker: Amanda Frost
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Constitution Article V and congressional or amendment proceedings
occurrences.quote_span: If the administration’s latest effort fails, supporters of further limits on birthright citizenship could turn to Congress or pursue a constitutional amendment, which would require approval by three-fourths of the states.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: Gene Hamilton statement reported by Fox News
occurrences.quote_span: "It's going to be interesting to see who actually does have standing to challenge this order," America First Legal co-founder and president Gene Hamilton told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Gene Hamilton
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: Public statements by Amanda Frost and David Bier
occurrences.quote_span: Frost and Bier both believe the new executive order should be ruled unconstitutional.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: David Bier statement reported by Fox News
occurrences.quote_span: "Congress ultimately establishes what it means to be subject to U.S. jurisdiction," Bier told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: David Bier
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal court filings challenging the August 6, 2026 birthright citizenship order
occurrences.quote_span: The same groups who challenged his initial order are now arguing that his new one unlawfully creates exceptions to birthright citizenship that conflict with the Supreme Court’s June ruling.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: Chad Mizelle statement reported by Fox News
occurrences.quote_span: "The Supreme Court has long recognized that there are exceptions to the 14th Amendment's birthright citizenship clause for the aliens who are considered children of invading armies or the children of ambassadors," America First Policy Institute senior fellow Chad Mizelle, who previously served as the Justice Department’s chief of staff, told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Chad Mizelle
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: Ilya Shapiro statement reported by Fox News
occurrences.quote_span: Shapiro says that the administration is on "solid ground" but noted that "if they had proceeded originally in this more targeted, narrower way" then the Supreme Court may not have ruled against them originally.
occurrences.speaker: Ilya Shapiro
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: Executive order implementation record and Maryland and New Hampshire court dockets
occurrences.quote_span: The order remains on the books but is not scheduled to take effect until Sept. 6, with a Maryland judge scheduled to hear an injunction request Aug. 28 and a related motion still pending in New Hampshire.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: Amanda Frost statement reported by Fox News
occurrences.quote_span: She said the Trump administration could potentially expand who is legally defined as a diplomat to preclude more people from birthright citizenship, but explained such a move would make it difficult to prosecute individuals for criminal offenses, a concern shared by Bier.
occurrences.speaker: Amanda Frost
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order

occurrences.checkable_against: David Bier statement reported by Fox News
occurrences.quote_span: "There's this very limited exception for accredited diplomats and everyone else in the United States is subject to U.S. laws so the idea that the president himself on his own authority can decide who is subject U. S. jurisdiction and U.S. laws is really a radical expansion and assertion of executive power and really would be unprecedented in the history of the United States."
occurrences.speaker: David Bier
occurrences.subject: Trump administration targeted birthright citizenship order
